rationale: The description specifies a live view of customer interactions, visibility of customer behavior for service agents, recording, and analytics to identify common errors and troublesome interaction areas. These are conventional monitoring, recording, and descriptive or diagnostic analytics; no predictive, learned, or generative mechanism is stated.
evidence_spans: Customer Service Analytics tools providing a live view of the customer interaction with our FiOS service
recording and analytics of customer behavior to help identify common errors made by the customer and areas of the customer interaction that prove more troublesome for the customer
conflict_response: The error-identification analytics are included, but the source frames them as recording and analytics for common errors and troublesome areas, not prediction or learned modeling. The concrete live-view and recording functions support a conventional negative without inventing a mechanism.
